status: Uncalibrated analytical serving estimates; no actual GPU execution
workload: One simultaneous cold-cache burst; identical sequences; no tools or retries; no prior queue

definitions.prefill_phase_input_tps: All uncached input tokens / time until all groups finish prefill
definitions.decode_phase_output_tps: All output tokens / common decode phase duration; only equal-sized active groups
definitions.per_request_decode_tps: 1 / modelled mean decode step; excludes prefill and service delay
definitions.wall_clock_output_tps: All output tokens / complete burst duration including prefill and service delay
definitions.wall_clock_total_tps: Input plus output tokens / same complete burst duration
definitions.burst_requests_per_s: Requests / complete burst duration; finite burst, not sustained-load capacity
definitions.ttft: Model first token, which can be reasoning or tool arguments; excludes client network latency

checks: equal-batch decode total / concurrency equals per-request decode
